wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 10-008 is the ai-specials-lane parity gate. It adds one test (test/plan_final/ai/gate-ai-specials.test.ts) mirroring the cast-free canonical lane-gate pattern over the seven ai prerequisites 10-001..10-007 (wire-monster-spawn-flags, wire-damage-and-targeting, wire-monster-look-chase, wire-monster-attacks, wire-state-transitions, wire-boss-specials, wire-special-line-ai-effects). For every prerequisite it asserts: plan_final/status/<id>.json exists, declares status=COMPLETED with the matching stepId, and records a commitSha of length >= 7 (proof the work was pushed); plan_final/evidence/<id>.json exists, declares zero knownFailures and typecheck=clean; the prerequisite focused test file exists under test/plan_final/ai/; and the gate covers exactly the seven-element ordered prerequisite set. The banned cast class (AGENTS.md L201/L222) is avoided by parsing into Record<string, unknown> (any -> Record requires no cast) and field-narrowing via String()/Array.isArray, with a poison sentinel for malformed knownFailures so corrupt prerequisite evidence fails the gate. The test imports nothing from a ../-prefixed src module, so no plan_vanilla_parity inventory module is affected (inventory-neutral; no probe/reconcile required). The step became eligible with all seven ai prerequisites COMPLETED.
